views.name: motorcycle_party_collisions
views.body_sql: SELECT c.case_id AS collision_id, p.id AS party_id, CASE WHEN p.party_safety_equipment_1 = 'driver, motorcycle helmet used' OR p.party_safety_equipment_2 = 'driver, motorcycle helmet used' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS helmet_status FROM collisions c JOIN parties p ON c.case_id = p.case_id WHERE c.motorcycle_collision = 1 AND p.party_type IN ('driver', 'passenger')
views.description: join collision and party tables, restrict to motorcycle collisions and driver/passenger roles, and derive a binary helmet status from safety equipment fields

views.name: collision_stats_by_helmet
views.body_sql:
SELECT 
    mpc.helmet_status,
    COUNT(mpc.collision_id) AS collision_count,
    SUM(c.killed_victims) AS fatality_count
FROM (
    SELECT DISTINCT collision_id, helmet_status
    FROM motorcycle_party_collisions
) mpc
JOIN collisions c ON mpc.collision_id = c.case_id
GROUP BY mpc.helmet_status
views.description: aggregate collision and fatality counts grouped by the derived helmet status
